Sheet.HeroFooter: Hit: d20 ≥ Defense · nat 20 double · stat 4–5 = advantage on checks · channel: 2 Life per missing MP, once per fight

Roll.AttackHint: Hits if ≥ target's Defense · nat 20 = double damage · nat 1 = fumble (roll d6)

Fumble.Title: Fumble!
Fumble.4: 4 wide open, next hit on you lands

Monster.Trick: Trick — the one thing they'll remember
Monster.TrickPlaceholder: Runs when half the pack falls…
Monster.Footer: Regular monsters +1/+2 · bosses +3/+4 · tougher = more Life, never more Defense

Magic.CastTip: Spend the MP and post the spell to chat; cantrips are free
Magic.ChanneledTip: Short on MP? Pay 2 Life per missing MP, once per fight. Untick when the fight ends.
Magic.ChannelBody: You are {missing} MP short. Channel {lifeCost} Life to cast {spell}?
Magic.AlreadyChanneled: You already channeled this fight. Untick the box when the fight ends.
Magic.CannotSurvive: Channeling would cost {lifeCost} Life and you have {life}. You cannot survive the cost.
Magic.AceReadyTip: Out of MP — your Ace is ready. Play it when the moment comes.
Magic.PlaceholderHint: Spell list is placeholder — fill SPELLS/CANTRIPS from docs/rulebook.md

Ace.PlayedTip: Played this session — untick to reset
Ace.OncePerSession: Once per session. The GM says yes.

Recover.OncePerFight: Once per fight — untick when it ends
Recover.NothingToTreat: Nothing to treat — Life is full

Flavor.bludgeoning: Smashes bone and shield — skeletons hate this
Flavor.cutting: Bleeds what has blood — fleshy things fear it
Flavor.piercing: Finds the gap in armor and scale

Tip.Name: Your hero's name — the table will shout it
Tip.Race: Where you come from; gives your trait
Tip.Profession: What you do; gives your move, Ace and kit
Tip.Stat: 1 to 5. At 4 or 5 you roll checks with advantage
Tip.Life: 0 Life = down, not dead. Max is 7 + CON × 2
Tip.MP: Spend to cast. Max is INT × 3. Comes back from crystals, places of power, or your own blood
Tip.Defense: 10 + armor. An attack hits you if its d20 is this or higher
Tip.Attack: Roll d20; hits if it meets the target's Defense. Nothing ever adds to this roll. Shift-click = advantage, Ctrl-click = disadvantage
Tip.Raging: +2 damage while ticked. Untick when the rage ends
Tip.Bonus: Extra flat damage from a blessing or a ruling. Clear it by hand
Tip.Fumble: Rolled a natural 1? Roll this d6 and read the result
Tip.WeaponName: What you swing. 📜 posts a usage card
Tip.WeaponDie: Damage die: d4 light, d6 standard, d8 heavy
Tip.WeaponStat: Damage adds STR for heavy weapons, AGI for quick or thrown ones
Tip.WeaponType: Bludgeoning smashes · cutting bleeds · piercing finds gaps. The GM may halve or double
Tip.WeaponReach: Touching = next to you · thrown = nearby · far = across the room
Tip.WeaponRoll: Roll damage: die + stat (+2 raging, + bonus)
Tip.WeaponCard: Post how this weapon is used
Tip.Ace: Once per session, your signature moment. Play it when the trigger happens
Tip.AceTrigger: When may you play it? e.g. "when an ally falls"
Tip.AceUsed: Ticked when played. Untick at the start of the next session
Tip.Gear: Everything you carry that is not a weapon
Tip.Treat: Heal half of your missing Life, rounded up. Once per fight
Tip.Treated: Ticked after treating. Untick when the fight ends
Tip.Potion: Drink: heal d6+2. Costs your turn
Tip.MonsterName: What the players will call it
Tip.MonsterLife: Tougher monsters get more Life, never more Defense
Tip.MonsterDefense: What the d20 must meet. 11–13 for most monsters
Tip.MonsterDie: Damage die; d10 for the nastiest
Tip.MonsterDtype: How it hurts: claws cut, clubs smash, fangs pierce
Tip.Trick: The one thing the table will remember about this monster
